name: Ripple
author: E. T. Carter
description: A grid of dots rippling like an LED matrix under water — concentric waves from two sources swell and shrink each dot as they pass and cross, crests brightening through the palette while troughs sink to near-black. Crisp, kinetic, rhythmic.

params.label: Dot count
params.effect: How many dots span the frame; low is a bold matrix, high a fine grid.

params.label: Ripple speed
params.effect: How fast the waves travel through the grid; 0 freezes them.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing between wave crests; low is tight rings, high broad swells.

params.label: Pulse
params.effect: How hard the dots swell and shrink with the wave; 0 is a steady grid.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer acts as a third ripple source; 0 ignores the mouse.
